discomName: Uttar Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam (UHBVN, HERC)

connectionTypes.sourceNote: SOURCED (secondary, cross-verified across 3 independent news reports) — HERC FY2025-26 Retail Supply Tariff Order (Petition No. 66 of 2024, dated 28.03.2025, effective 01.04.2025): LT Industrial 'supply at 11 kVAh' energy charge raised to Rs 6.95/kVAh (from Rs 6.65) and fixed/demand charge raised to Rs 290/kVA/month (from Rs 165); rate is technically per kVA of contract demand, applied here via the perLoad/perKW field per this dataset's convention for kVA-billed categories. Cross-verified identically across https://www.indiatvnews.com/haryana/haryana-power-regulator-announces-new-tariff-hikes-electricity-rates-here-s-how-much-you-will-pay-2025-04-02-983459, https://theprint.in/india/haryana-power-regulator-announces-new-tariff-hikes-electricity-rates/2574654/, and https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/headlines/3330612-herc-unveils-2025-26-tariff-order-power-rates-rise-in-haryana. The primary HERC order PDF (herc.gov.in/WriteReadData/Orders/O20250328.pdf) and UHBVN's own sales circular (uhbvn.org.in) are scanned image PDFs with no extractable text and could not be verified directly; HERC's website was also unreachable during verification.

verifiedBy: SOURCED (secondary) — Haryana domestic tariff from secondary references; pending primary SERC order cross-check. FPPCA fuel surcharge and electricity duty are not modelled here.
